q.en: The sum of the interior angles of a regular hexagon is
q.as: এটা সুষম ষড়ভুজৰ অন্তঃকোণবোৰৰ যোগফল কিমান

q.en: Triangles ABC and DEF are similar, with AB = 6 cm, DE = 9 cm and BC = 8 cm. Find EF.

q.en: In triangle ABC, AD bisects angle A. If AB = 6 cm, AC = 8 cm and BD = 3 cm, find DC.
